gmcm.enable.name: Show markers
gmcm.enable.tip: A bouncing exclamation mark over the people and monsters your quests need.
gmcm.deliveries.name: Mark deliveries
gmcm.deliveries.tip: Mark the person an item must be delivered to.
gmcm.carried.name: Only when carried
gmcm.carried.tip: Mark a delivery person only while you carry enough of the item.
gmcm.turnin.name: Mark hand-ins
gmcm.turnin.tip: Mark the person to go back to once a kill, fishing or gathering quest is done.
gmcm.socialize.name: Mark people to meet
gmcm.socialize.tip: Mark the villagers a quest such as Introductions still needs you to greet.
gmcm.monsters.name: Mark monsters
gmcm.monsters.tip: Mark the monsters a kill quest asks for.
gmcm.hints.name: Add notes to quests
gmcm.hints.tip: Add progress and help lines to the end of a quest in the quest log.
gmcm.fish.name: Fishing help
gmcm.fish.tip: Say where, when and in what weather the fish of a fishing quest bites.
gmcm.shops.name: Where to buy
gmcm.shops.tip: Say which shops sell the item of a delivery or gathering quest.
gmcm.recipes.name: Recipe help
gmcm.recipes.tip: Say how to craft or cook an item a quest asks for.
gmcm.where.name: Where people are
gmcm.where.tip: Say where the person of a quest is right now.
gmcm.nameicons.name: Pictures beside names
gmcm.nameicons.tip: Put the villager's portrait or the item's picture in front of its name in the quest log.
gmcm.itemmarks.name: Quest item marks
gmcm.itemmarks.tip: Mark the items a quest wants with a small exclamation mark in the backpack, chests and toolbar, and say why in the tooltip.
gmcm.donations.name: Donation box list
gmcm.donations.tip: Beside a special order donation box, list what the order still needs.
gmcm.expiring.name: Warn on the last day
gmcm.expiring.tip: Show a message when a timed quest, such as a Help Wanted request, is on its last day.
gmcm.fix.name: Repair meeting quests
gmcm.fix.tip: When a save loads, remove people who no longer exist from a quest such as Introductions, so it can be finished.
